status: Post hoc explanatory diagnostic; specified during the running main campaign, before executing this diagnostic
motivation: Examine limitations of model-relative finite-scenario feasibility when a saved causal policy is transported to the true simulated plant and noisy future observations.

selection.case_source: Full frozen main-campaign manifest order, required to agree with its saved protocol cases
selection.unit: One saved remaining-horizon policy at one selected method/case/stage
selection.missing_and_failed: Retain every planned slot, including missing/failed episodes, absent stage policies and failed replays. No replacement or outcome-based selection.

intervention.start: The selected decision's saved true_start_state, converted once to physical amounts
intervention.policy: Hold saved theta, reference and basis fixed for the entire remaining horizon; no estimator, optimizer or replanning
intervention.first_action: Use base theta[0] with the common physical guard; no feedback correction at the first remaining interval
intervention.future_observations: At each subsequent global interval g, add case.noise[g,0:2] to the counterfactual plant's own log biomass amounts; add case.noise[g,2] to glucose concentration with the saved nonnegative clipping convention. Volume is observed exactly.
intervention.future_feedback: Use z_observed = log(M_SC/M_KP) + noise[g,0] - noise[g,1] in the fixed saved policy; never use a saved future realized state
intervention.plant: Use the case's actual family, inhibition and future affinity path only inside this retrospective independent plant replay
intervention.integration: Independent physical-amount interval method; carry each counterfactual endpoint forward without resetting to saved actual states
intervention.scope: Counterfactual forecast transport, not the realized deployed controller, which replans at every stage

comparisons.forecast_envelope: Saved finite-scenario minimum and maximum terminal log ratio; report exact containment and containment after the separately stated 2e-6 numerical cushion
comparisons.discrepancy: Counterfactual true terminal log ratio minus saved center-scenario prediction, and signed/absolute distance outside the saved finite-scenario envelope
comparisons.target: True terminal log-ratio target error, with both design-band and actual acceptance-band indicators and physical validity
comparisons.model_feasible_counterfactual_failed: Saved selected.feasible is true, replay completes, and true counterfactual terminal/physical acceptance fails. Report count and completed model-feasible denominator; unavailable model-feasible slots remain separate.
comparisons.realized_outcome: Save the original full-episode terminal_feasible, operational_success, log_ratio_error and controller_failure separately; do not equate them with counterfactual results
comparisons.guard_or_gate_causality: No causal false-accept attribution. Selected model feasibility and a managed LP gate acceptance are distinct fields.

inference_limits: This is a post hoc explanatory diagnostic, not a new validation endpoint or a tuned controller evaluation.
The every-tenth-case subset follows the frozen ordering and is not a random or balanced sample of regimes.
Policies at several stages share episodes and methods share cases; policy counts are correlated and are reported descriptively without independence-based confidence intervals.
Finite model-scenario extrema are not a confidence interval or a bound on all parameter/noise realizations.
The replay combines hidden plant mismatch, initial observation error and future observation noise; it does not identify their separate causal effects.
A failed numerical replay is unknown feasibility, not evidence of a target miss; missing and failed slots remain visible in denominators.
No campaign output, controller setting or frozen audit source is modified.
